12 Ron Hill/Lara Surrey Classic 10 kms, Oxshott: Maria Sharp and Richard Ward made their first appearances in Belgrave colours and both won their respective races.

Maria Sharp had no sooner finished her opening stage for our women's team than she was tearing back down the course to urge on her Stephen. Stephen Sharp has been in cracking form and we expected him to move us very close to the lead.
After a strong run in the Southerns on the anchor leg, Maria Sharp wanted to reverse the order and lead off, figuring that starting up with the main pack would pull her around to a faster time.

One of Belgrave's keenest supporters and racers, Maria Sharp has been the cornerstone of our women's road relay teams. And we're pretty sure it won't be long before she's taking a team medal home with her.

The irrepressible Maria Sharp was the unlucky person to find herself "only" in third when she tackled the 800m. Canny Kevin Nash ignored the pace of an early leader in the steeplechase and gradually overhauled him to post yet another win.
And then Stephen Sharp beat the talented Woodford junior Chris Reynolds in a sprint for the line to make the 1500m another exciting and closely contested race.

Maria Sharp had a double first in the 800m (2:19.4) and 3,000m (10:11.5), an event where W40 Jacinta Moore made a surprise reappearance having been a regular and reliable competitor in this league some years ago.
